title: Unemployment rate
note: The unemployment rate is the share of people in the labor force who have no job and look for one. The rate uses where people live, not where they work. It is not adjusted for seasons. The 2025 value is an average of 11 months, without October 2025. So it does not fully compare with other years. It is not a count of open jobs. It is not one person's chance of finding a job.
